categories.main_business_segments: Anhui Estone Materials Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in advanced inorganic non-metallic composite materials and application solutions. Its main product categories include inorganic functional powder materials such as boehmite, silica powder, spherical alumina powder, and polymer materials including nano-composite flame retardants and ceramic silicone rubber flame retardants. These products are widely used in new energy lithium batteries, electronic communications, chip packaging, copper-clad laminates, and fire safety fields.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages proprietary technologies in producing high-purity boehmite for lithium battery coating materials, spherical alumina for thermal management and chip packaging, and advanced polymer composite flame retardants. It has developed automated production lines and specialized equipment such as fluidized bed jet mills and surface modification devices to ensure product quality and efficiency. The company also invests heavily in R&D, focusing on innovations like small particle size boehmite, ceramicized polymer materials, and solid oxide fuel cell (SOC) systems, with a strong patent portfolio supporting its technological edge.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include domestic and international lithium battery manufacturers, wet-process diaphragm manufacturers, leading new energy vehicle companies, electronics and semiconductor firms, and chip packaging enterprises. The company serves markets in new energy vehicles, consumer electronics, advanced communication (5G), artificial intelligence, and automotive sectors. Its boehmite products have a global market presence, including supply to overseas factories in Europe and Southeast Asia.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with production and R&D centers in Anhui Province, including Hefei and Bengbu. It also has subsidiaries and joint ventures in South Korea and Chongqing, expanding its footprint in Asia. Overseas sales and supply extend to Europe and Southeast Asia, reflecting a growing international market presence.
categories.supply_chain_position: Anhui Estone Materials Technology Co., Ltd. operates upstream and midstream in the supply chain, focusing on the production of advanced functional powder materials and polymer composites that serve as critical inputs for downstream manufacturers in lithium batteries, electronics, and automotive industries. It controls key raw material processing and product manufacturing stages, supplying essential materials to battery and electronic component producers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in lithium battery safety materials, electronic communication functional fillers, and polymer flame retardants. It is advancing the industrialization of new technologies such as small particle size boehmite, ceramicized flame retardants, high-purity synthetic quartz sand, and solid oxide fuel cell systems. R&D efforts emphasize product performance optimization, cost reduction, and expanding applications in emerging fields like sodium-ion batteries and semi-solid lithium batteries. The company also fosters academic collaborations and maintains a robust patent portfolio to sustain technological leadership.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the direct sale of advanced inorganic functional powder materials and polymer composite products. The company employs a direct sales model supplemented by distributors, serving both domestic and international customers. Revenue streams include product sales to lithium battery manufacturers, electronics firms, and new energy vehicle companies, with some income from government subsidies and investment returns.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a leading position globally in the lithium battery boehmite market, maintaining the largest market share worldwide. It competes with other domestic and international suppliers of inorganic coating materials and electronic fillers. Its competitive advantages stem from technological innovation, product quality, diversified product lines, and strong customer relationships. The industry is characterized by high concentration, with the top three players holding 73% market share, and the company is recognized as a national manufacturing champion.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 504.5 million, representing an 8.6% year-over-year increase. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 12 million, a decline of 51% compared to the previous year, mainly due to product price decreases and raw material cost fluctuations. Total assets reached RMB 3.22 billion, up 8.4% year-over-year. The company continues to invest heavily in R&D, with expenditures accounting for 9.57% of revenue. It has a workforce of 766 employees, including 139 R&D personnel.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its unique value in providing high-purity, low-magnetic impurity, and small particle size boehmite materials that enhance lithium battery safety and performance. Its products improve battery thermal stability, puncture resistance, and energy density. In electronic materials, its spherical alumina offers superior thermal conductivity and low alpha radiation for advanced chip packaging. The polymer flame retardants provide high self-extinguishing properties and ceramic formation under fire conditions. The company’s integrated R&D, customized solutions, and advanced manufacturing capabilities differentiate it as a reliable technology partner in high-end markets.
